Zeta23.OPICAFollowup.weighted_mobius_inv.statement: For every complex mixer with exponential moment a > 1/2: eta = N * sigma per Jordan coordinate of the actual mixture and in positive Jordan form; M+ * N = delta_0 + M- * N; sigma = M_mu * eta for real and imaginary parts in positive Jordan form; all weighted norms finite; exact multiplicativity of int e^(-a y) for the genuine product-measure convolution; ||N|| = zeta(a+1/2); M+ and M- mutually singular and ||M+ + M-|| = sum mu(n)^2 n^(-a-1/2) = zeta(a+1/2)/zeta(2a+1).
Zeta23.OPICAFollowup.weighted_mobius_inv.method: Positive lattice measure algebra (divisor-antidiagonal regrouping of positive double series), finite divisor identity for mu, cancellation of locally finite measures on intervals, Mathlib Euler products for zeta(s) and the squarefree series.
Zeta23.OPICAFollowup.weighted_mobius_inv.formalization_choice: Signed identities stated in positive Jordan form; every term has finite weighted norm, so they are the signed identities of the weighted algebra.

Zeta23.OPICAFollowup.weighted_mixture_sh.statement: Canonical Fourier self-duality of the actual mixture distribution and nu.variationControl(Ioo(-1,1) minus {0}) = 0 force sigma = c delta_0 coordinatewise, nu = c Sha with c the origin atom, and zero origin atom forces zero.
Zeta23.OPICAFollowup.weighted_mixture_sh.method: Fourier transport law and faithfulness give sigma reflected = sigma; the gap makes eta vanish on the negative axis; causality of M_mu transfers it to sigma; evenness concentrates sigma at 0.

Zeta23.OPICAFollowup.weighted_gap_leakag.statement: (1) zeta(2a+1)/zeta(a+1/2) int_(-oo,0) e^(-a t) d|sigma| <= int_(0,1) x^(-a-1/2) d|nu| with genuine complex variations, plus per-Jordan-part and coordinate-control forms; (2) HT1.9 endpoint supremum form without b-moment; (3) finite a-moments for a < b; (4) endpoint witness with infinite b-moment; (5) r_h is the actual positive-axis density of the mixture of h(t) dt.
Zeta23.OPICAFollowup.weighted_gap_leakag.method: Real rotations of compact restrictions have no larger variation; exact bound |int g dnu| <= int g d|nu| for nonnegative weights via vector-measure integrals; log transport dominated by transport of |nu|; causal Mobius expansion on bounded negative-axis sets; Mathlib variation_le_of_forall_enorm_le.
